import numpy as np, pandas as pd, lmfit
df=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv'); x=df.shift_cm1.values; y=df.intensity.values
def lor(x,A,x0,w): return A*(w/2)**2/((x-x0)**2+(w/2)**2)
def fit_window(lo,hi,centers,label):
    m=(x>lo)&(x<hi); xx=x[m]; yy=y[m]
    p=lmfit.Parameters()
    p.add('c0',value=np.median(yy),min=0)
    p.add('c1',value=0.0)
    for i,c in enumerate(centers):
        p.add(f'A{i}',value=max(yy)-np.median(yy),min=0)
        p.add(f'x{i}',value=c,min=c-6,max=c+6)
        p.add(f'w{i}',value=5,min=0.5,max=40)
    def model(p):
        out=p['c0']+p['c1']*(xx-xx.mean())
        for i in range(len(centers)):
            out=out+lor(xx,p[f'A{i}'],p[f'x{i}'],p[f'w{i}'])
        return out
    r=lmfit.minimize(lambda p:model(p)-yy,p)
    print('==',label,'chi2/dof', round(r.redchi,1),'N',len(xx))
    for i in range(len(centers)):
        A=r.params[f'A{i}'];x0=r.params[f'x{i}'];w=r.params[f'w{i}']
        se=lambda n: r.params[n].stderr
        print(f'  x0={x0.value:8.2f}±{se(f"x{i}") or 0:.2f}  FWHM={w.value:6.2f}±{se(f"w{i}") or 0:.2f}  A={A.value:9.1f}±{se(f"A{i}") or 0:.1f}')
    return r
fit_window(500,545,[520.7],'Si window')
fit_window(230,290,[241,263.5],'240-265 window')
fit_window(330,400,[368.6],'368 window')
fit_window(100,150,[124],'124 window')
EOF
